# ZEISS

> ZEISS is a global leader in optics and optoelectronics, delivering precision optical solutions across semiconductor manufacturing, medical technology, vision care, industrial metrology, and extended reality applications.

ZEISS operates as a diversified technology company with multiple specialized divisions serving critical industries from chip fabrication to surgical imaging. The company combines over 175 years of optical innovation with cutting-edge digital solutions and advanced manufacturing capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology (SMT)
- Medical Technology
- Vision Care
- Extended Reality (XR/AR/VR)
- Industrial Metrology
- EUV Lithography
- Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM)
- Optical Solutions
- Digital Solutions
- Ophthalmology
- Surgical Microscopes
- 3D Scanning
- Photochromic Lenses
- Corporate Governance
- Sustainability

## Industrial Metrology & Quality Solutions

- [ZEISS Industrial Quality Solutions USA](https://www.zeiss.com/metrology): ZEISS metrology precision measurement technology: CMMs, 3D scanning, industrial CT solutions
- [ZEISS Metrology Systems](https://www.zeiss.com/metrology/products/systems.html): ZEISS coordinate measuring machines and optical metrology systems for quality inspection
- [ZEISS Metrology Shop - Just grab it online.](https://shop.metrology.zeiss.com): ZEISS Metrology online shop: 6000+ CMM accessories, styli, and training products

## Vision Care & Optical Products

- [Plano sun lenses by ZEISS Sunlens | Sunlens Supplier & Manufacturer](https://www.zeiss.com/sunlens): ZEISS Sunlens B2B supplier of sun lenses, photochromic and polarized eyewear technology
- [ZEISS Extended Reality](https://www.zeiss.com/extended-reality): ZEISS Extended Reality optical solutions for XR, AR, and VR applications and devices
